title: Weak relative Noether normalization by a quasi-finite polynomial-algebra map with the maximal fibre dimension
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: Approximation must preserve the global fibre-dimension bound while reducing to finite-type integer algebras. A double induction then constructs a coordinate dropping all fibre dimensions, first by transcendence at generic components and then by the perturbation a^n+b to reconcile an open stratum with its closed complement.
